two lands on the battlefield.
You control at least one basic land.
description:
Activate both lands to add {2}.
Activate Meloku twice by paying {2} and returning both lands to your hand to create two 1/1 blue Illusion tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an Illusion token to untap the basic land.
Activate the basic land for {1}.
Activate Patron of the Moon, putting two lands from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping both lands.
Repeat.
